we proposed a novel neural bootstrapping method for neural processes to improve the functional uncertainty modeling and achieved state-of-the-art results in Bayesian optimization and contextual bandit.
we propose Neural Bootstrapping Attention (NeuB) for Neural Process (NP), which can be used to improve the performance of NPs in Bayesian Optimization and Multi-armed Bandits.

we proposed an efficient and easy to implement approach, Neural Bootsrapping Attentive neural processes (NeuBAnp) which can learn to fit stochastic processes with neural network and can capture diverse patterns in stochastic processes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how to learn to generate the functional uncertainty of random functions, which is an important aspect in the stochastic process modeling.
how to efficiently model functional uncertainty for stochastic processes, and we propose NeuBANP, a novel approach that achieves state-of-the-arts in two benchmark experiments.
how to improve the functional uncertainty modeling in stochastic process modeling and how to apply it to sequential decision-making tasks.

NeuBANP is a novel method that improves the quality of modeling functional uncertainty in neural stochastic processes.
our proposed model NeuBANP improves the functional uncertainty modeling and achieves state-of-the- art results in sequential decision-making tasks.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
our method improves the quality of the functional uncertainty modeling in Neural Process, and thus achieves better performance in sequential decision-making tasks.
we propose a novel and efficient approach to capture the functional stochastic processes, which achieves state-of-the art performance in both of sequential decision-making problems.

we propose a new neural network architecture, Neural Bootstraping Attentive Neural Process (NeuBAP) for modeling functional uncertainty, which is more efficient, parallelizable and memory-efficient than previous approaches.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the functional uncertainty of stochastic processes can be captured by bootstrapping the latent variables of neural networks.
bootstrapping can be an effective and efficient way to capture the functional uncertainties in the stochastic processes.
bootstrapping can be efficiently implemented by injecting multiple random weight matrices to the encoder and the decoder, and the functional uncertainty can be effectively learned by bootstrapping.
